verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote in the right order and puts it on a dark centred panel, so it reads; but the image is cropped to two disembodied shoulders with no head, the panel is a hard opaque slab that wasn't in the original, and the attribution and small copy are small and cramped. B has broken reading order (Albert Einstein sits between SCIENCE and RELIGION, and the 'blind' and 'lame' lines are swapped and paired with the wrong headwords); RELIGION has shrunk to subhead size; text sits right on the busy, bright image with poor contrast; and an orphan dark rectangle floats over the left side for no reason.
